messages:
maya: running comparison between orion-lite-q4 export and the fp16 baseline on zh-Hant -> en news set, BLEU drop ~ -3.1. suspicious punctuation shifts around numbers and percentage signs.
devin: can you paste a minimal repro and tokenizer traces?
maya: small reproducer pasted below

```
input: 3
0% 	


2025






baseline (fp16): 3% in 2025, growth was 1,234.
orion-q4: 3% in 2025, growth was 1234.
```

maya: note the thousands separator turned into U+001F (unit separator control) in q4 run for some examples, and sometimes into IDEOGRAPHIC COMMA U+3001.
alex: U+001F? that's a control char, weird. sounds like a detok buffer overrun or an uninitialized slot leaking.
devin: tokenization outputs?
maya: yes

```
baseline.tokens: ["1", ",234", ",", " ", "growth", " ", "was"]
orion-q4.tokens: ["1", "\u001f234", " ", "growth", " ", "was"]
```

devin: looks like the comma byte got replaced during detok step. could be that quant kernel writes punctuation indices into an 8-bit table and the mapping table wasn't fully initialized, so occasionally we read 0x1F.
ci-bot: eval job #9123 finished: BLEU delta -3.1 (stat significant). Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/orion-q4/9123

alex: are there production parsers relying on ASCII comma/dot? any customer impact?
sre-luis: yes, a few ingestion pipelines parse numbers with regex expecting [0-9,]+; control chars break the JSON that downstream jobs expect. we had 2 errors in canary ingestion last night.
maya: repro script: /tmp/orion-detok-control-repro.sh; export commit: b4c3d2a; quant flags: --mode q4_0 --detok fast-mode
devin: quick mitigation: add a post-detok sanitizer that normalizes known punctuations to ASCII equivalents and strips control characters between digits. cheap and safe as a guardrail. I can add in serving shim.
alex: do it temporarily but also start bisect on the runtime quant detok path to find when the mapping initialization changed.
devin: creating bisect: https://ci.internal/ci/jobs/bisect-detok-7622
ci-bot: bisect queued, approx run time 1.5h.

maya: adding regression test under tests/locale/zh_numeric_control_sanitizer.json with a couple of failing samples.
devin: patch incoming: "serving/shims/detok_sanitize.cc" adds regex replace: replace /([0-9])[^0-9\u002C\u002E\u3001\u00B7]+([0-9])/ -> insert ',' between digits and drop control chars. Will deploy to canary.
alex: also add unit in runtime-export checks to dump detok table bytes and diff between fp16 and q4 artifacts during export. this should have caught the missing initialization.
sre-luis: routing fallback: re-route zh->en traffic to fp16 model for affected routes. done.
maya: filing ticket RD-4750 "Quantized detok init bug causing non-printable punctuation in CJK numeric contexts"; tagging eng-ml, eng-runtime, eng-sre. https://tickets.internal/RD-4750

devin: once bisect results are back I'll post the commit range. until then sanitizer + fallback should stop customer errors. :thumbsup:
